title: Authority + Autonomy Binding
rules: Permissions, entitlements, policy, governance, assurance, evidence and approvals remain required by the existing authority evaluator.
Verified Titan Autonomy snapshot is required where the existing evaluator requires it.
Risk caps, Trusted Auto handshake and Predictive readiness remain owned by the existing authority evaluator.
Only ALLOW decisions can be forwarded to the existing Command Bus preparation seam.
